new_attributes.name: knee_lifts_forward
new_attributes.text: While standing on one leg, the other thigh swings up in front so the knee rises ahead of the hip.
new_attributes.definition: From a standing support on one foot, the thigh of the other leg swings up in front of the body so the knee joint rises clearly forward of and up toward the height of the hip, with the ankle below or in front of the knee, and then lowers again. A knee that bends only to bring the heel up behind the body while the thigh stays vertical does not count, and thighs that become horizontal only because the hips lower onto a seat do not count.

run_on_the_spot.label: has2
run_on_the_spot.evidence: each knee lifts forward in front of the hip on alternating legs

butt_kicks.label: lacks2
butt_kicks.evidence: thigh stays vertical; the heel rises behind toward the buttocks instead

step_on_foot.label: has2
step_on_foot.evidence: actor lifts the right knee in front before stamping down

kicking_something.label: has2
kicking_something.evidence: right leg swings forward and up, knee rising in front of the hip

kicking.label: has1
kicking.evidence: right leg swings forward and up toward the partner; low kicks lift the knee less

side_kick.label: has1
side_kick.evidence: right knee lifts in front before the leg extends to the side

put_on_a_shoe.label: has1
put_on_a_shoe.evidence: one leg is raised with the knee bent toward the hands when standing

take_off_a_shoe.label: has1
take_off_a_shoe.evidence: one leg is lifted with the knee bent toward the hands when standing

jump_up.label: lacks1
jump_up.evidence: both knees bend and straighten together; no single knee lifts in front

sit_down.label: lacks1
sit_down.evidence: thighs become horizontal by the hips lowering, with both feet on the floor
